statements.t: Management’s plans to continue as a going concern include raising additional capital, including through a potential registered offering of equity securities, as well as borrowings, continuing to focus on attaining profitable operations, and exploring alternative funding sources on an as needed basis.
However, management cannot provide any assurances that the Company will be successful in accomplishing any of its plans.
The supply chain constraints, inflationary pressures and tariffs are expected to impact to some extent our operations and reduced access to capital.

Although the Company remained in compliance with all financial covenants under the Credit Agreement as of September 30, 2026, management concluded that substantial doubt exists because anticipated operating cash flows and liquidity remain dependent upon obtaining additional financing or achieving sustained profitability.
There can be no assurance that the Company will be able to renew, extend or refinance the Senior Facilities, or obtain additional financing, on acceptable terms or at all.
